title: Eric Ries on TikTok: 'Panera killed people after it got taken over by private equity'
summary: Eric's sharpest TikTok of the launch run so far — a private-equity / lethal-product case study in 60 seconds. Best-performing Eric TikTok since the launch ramp began: 1,116 plays and 17 likes in under 24 hours.
blockquote: *Panera killed people after it got taken over by private equity and I'm going to prove it to you*
